about_the_game:
Enjoy the symphony of sounds from The Great Coffee Caper whenever you please!

Dearest shopper! Has this ever happened to you???

"A collection of MP3 files (and high quality audio...) have never been so alluring!
How can I be satisfied? How will this calamity end!?"
- someone who hasn't bought the soundtrack

Dearest shopper, my dearest shopper! Thanks to the incredible work of Zectro, you can solve the mystery of your misery with this delectable soundtrack!

Includes both MP3 and WAV versions of the Soundtrack

legal_notice:
Copyright & DMCA Policy for The Great Coffee Caper Soundtrack
The music from The Great Coffee Caper is copyrighted, but we want to make sure content creators can use it without issues.

Allowed: You are free to use the soundtrack in your content and live streams, whether monetized or not, as long as it is part of other content (e.g., gameplay, commentary, reviews).

Not Allowed: The music cannot be used for advertising, in other games, or in trailers for other games. Uploading or streaming the music by itself without additional content is also not permitted

Our goal is to ensure that streamers and video creators can use the OST as background music without worrying about DMCA claims. If you run into any issues, feel free to reach out!
